mapper.sql: FROM publication_state s JOIN publication_release r ON r.id=s.live_release_id WHERE r.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND s.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND s.enabled=TRUE AND r.mcp_tool_enabled=TRUE AND r.lifecycle_status != 'RETIRED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM publication_release_scope rs JOIN access_scope sc ON sc.code=rs.scope_code WHERE rs.release_id=r.id AND sc.enabled=TRUE)

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mcp_tool_set_member m JOIN mcp_tool_set ts ON ts.id=m.tool_set_id WHERE ts.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND m.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND m.tool_set_id=#{toolSetId} AND m.api_id=r.api_id AND ts.enabled=TRUE)

mapper.select: SELECT id,name FROM catalog_api_draft WHERE environment_id=#{environmentId} AND id IN #{id}
